messages:
sophia: Draft's ready for a final quick-pass + ops handshake. Pasting critical bits here. DO NOT PUBLISH yet. Target publish: Tue 9am PT. Need: claim checks, benchmark wording, webinar CTA, HubSpot mapping. @mike_marketing @alyssa_design @kevin_ops please review by EOD.

mike_marketing: On it. I'll sanity-check benchmark numbers and the 'cost per token' blurb. Suggest we tighten hero to 'up to 3x throughput' but call out test conditions.

alyssa_design: Quick visual notes: use portrait crop for hero, brand-blue token-eco for throughput bar, full-bleed preferred. Uploading assets now.

kevin_ops: Ops notes: HubSpot form needs hidden fields for routing and a demo owner. Also want a canary segment for the first 1k registrants. Share exact form id and hidden props.

henry_sales: Sales ask: CTA copy should be 'Register for the launch demo — limited seats'. If we include pricing hints, tag me and Ill draft follow-ups.

mike_marketing: I'll add a short FAQ on benchmark methodology and inline the test conditions: "results on Llama-Tiny with seq=512, batch=8" under the Benchmarks section.

natalie_legal: Quick-pass done. Remove the word 'guaranteed' from SLA example, use 'targeted' instead.

content-bot: Reminder: publish checklist fields outstanding: hero alt text, HubSpot form id, demo ops owner.

kevin_ops: Example mapping to paste in doc: ```hubspot_form: launch_demo_v2
hidden_fields: {\"source\":\"launch_blog\", \"demo_path\":\"orbit-2025\"}
owner: ops-demo@redwood.ai``` Once included I can wire the webhook to /demo-scheduler and create the canary.

alyssa_design: Hero + 3 images uploaded to Figma (link in doc). Alt text added in Figma comments.

kevin_ops: Ops checklist: 1) Confirm HubSpot id + hidden fields 2) Create canary segment (1k) 3) Verify inbound webhook to /demo-scheduler 4) Add fallback calendar if >80% capacity.

henry_sales: Please map these HubSpot props: `campaign_source`, `demo_interest_level` (low/med/high), `acct_tier` (self-serve/enterprise) for SDR prioritization.

sophia: Summary & owners: - Mike: finalize benchmark wording + add test conditions (by 3pm PT) - Alyssa: lock hero asset + alt text (by 4pm PT) - Natalie: legal tweak accepted - Kevin: HubSpot mapping + canary (by EOD) - Henry: follow-up templates (tomorrow AM). I'll update the doc and hand to release-ops if all signoffs complete. :rocket:

sophia: Publishing checklist snippet copied for ops: ```PUBLISH-ORBIT-CHECKLIST
- Copy locked (content + legal signoff)
- Hero assets uploaded + alt text
- HubSpot form id + hidden fields set
- Canary segment created (1k seats)
- Demo webhook connected to /demo-scheduler
- SDR templates ready
- Tracking UTMs: utm_source=launch_blog, utm_medium=organic, utm_campaign=orbit_launch
```

mike_marketing: Marketing approved. Benchmarks language updated in doc.

natalie_legal: Legal approved updated wording.

kevin_ops: Ops signed off on mapping and canary. Scheduling test run at 5pm PT.

henry_sales: I'll drop 3 follow-up variants in the doc by 10am tomorrow.

sophia: Thanks everyone  locking copy and assigning to release-ops. Will follow up with the publish runbook and test results. :white_check_mark:
